cv.name: Chloe Harrington
cv.headline: Residential Property Manager | Inner-north Brisbane portfolio
cv.summary: Licensed property manager with four years in residential real estate across Brisbane's inner north. Comfortable managing a full portfolio from listing to bond refund, and known by landlords for clear communication and tidy arrears.

experience.title: Property Manager
bullets: Manage a portfolio of 165 residential properties for private and SMSF investors
Routine inspections, entry and exit condition reports, and maintenance coordination with trades
Kept arrears below 1% for eight consecutive months
Prepare QCAT applications and attend hearings for bond disputes

experience.title: Leasing Consultant / Assistant Property Manager
bullets: Ran up to 20 open homes a week and processed tenancy applications
Supported two senior property managers with lease renewals and rent reviews

education.degree: Certificate IV in Real Estate Practice

skills: Residential Tenancies and Rooming Accommodation Act 2008 (Qld)
